description.text:
The Travel Theme Pack (游历专题包) is a two-card pack sold only inside gift boxes, all on sale from 7 November 2025. Pokémon China made it to mark the journey since the Simplified Chinese game began the Scarlet & Violet series, with the Pokémon of Paldea and the collecting of Pokédex numbers 001 to 151 in Collect 151. The first card is a Pokémon card already seen in the series, or with luck a shiny holo. The second can be a holo basic Energy or, with more luck, a new art illustration holo, a Special Art Rare of Greninja ex, Iron Hands ex, Mew ex or Charizard ex, a Special Art Rare of Wo-Chien ex, Chi-Yu ex or Miraidon ex in a new finish, or a gold basic Energy.

The packs came in four kinds of box. The Travel Collection Accessory Box (收藏周边礼盒 游历) held one pack, a damage-counter case shaped like a Pokémon or an Energy type in one of 37 designs (26 regular, 4 hidden and 7 super-hidden), a 20-card Bonus Round, Dark Crystal Blaze or True Mystery pack and a 5-card Collect 151 pack. The Travel Battle Accessory Box (对战周边礼盒 游历) held one pack and a set of card sleeves in one of 37 designs, with booster packs. The four Travel Gift Boxes (游历礼盒), Greninja, Iron Hands, Mew and Charizard, each held six Travel Theme Packs, three identical 20-card boosters and three identical 20-card Collect 151 packs, with that Pokémon's sleeves, coin die and card box, and four damage-counter dice. The silver and black Road of Travels Gift Box (游历之路礼盒) held 18 Travel Theme Packs and two 20-card packs of each of the ten boosters released in 2025, with sleeves, a deck box, a playmat and a playmat case.

Its cards are numbered out of 52: the Pokémon cards, Pokémon ex among them, are 001 to 052. Shiny holos, art illustrations, shiny Pokémon ex, the Special Art Rares and the gold Energy are numbered past it, up to 139.
